name: head_tail_by_ticking
description: head_by and tail_by of a keyed input table, of its sort and of its flatten, which shifts the rows behind a deleted one, through rows added at the end and in the middle of a group, rows modified among the kept rows and outside them, rows that change group, to a new group in the cycle that adds another new group, deletes that empty groups and the table, groups that come back, with a signed zero that differs from the first one, and cycles that change nothing.
